The '''Forscan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] that contained the planets [[Forscan IV]] and [[Forscan VI]]. It was also the site of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] clothes-legging scam.
